info.name: SwiftRide API Collection
info.description:
Run all folders in order with SwiftRide Local environment. Set demo_password to SWIFTRIDE_DEMO_PASSWORD. Runtime variables are stored only in the environment, avoiding collection/environment shadowing. Happy path, cancellation, rejection, security and manual payments use separate fixtures. This runner creates test data; manual charges are refunded, main-trip automatic payment remains in the ledger. Dev simulator uses an already cancelled fixture. No request logs JWTs.

Import both JSON files and select the SwiftRide Local environment. Run the entire collection in order; set demo_password to the value of SWIFTRIDE_DEMO_PASSWORD in .env. For Newman use: newman run postman/SwiftRide.postman_collection.json -e postman/SwiftRide.postman_environment.json --timeout-script 35000. The settlement check may wait up to 25 seconds. Run one iteration at a time. The full run creates labelled test records; use a development database. SignalR tests use Long Polling, not WebSocket.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('demo_password')) throw new Error('Set demo_password to SWIFTRIDE_DEMO_PASSWORD from .env');
